chunks: Likewise, whatever was in it from Hammad ibn Isa.
ai.seo_question: What does this transmission note indicate about narrations from Hammad ibn Isa in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This brief statement is part of the author’s clarification of the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Hammad ibn Isa in this book. It serves as a transmission note identifying that these narrations belong to the same documented chain of transmission.
